text:
Alex P: Quick sync — finalizing criteria for pilot sponsor selection. low-key thread to capture ideas before we make a shortlist.
Maria G: +1. need criteria + outreach cadence. also how we route feedback (PM <> eng <> solutions).
Jamie L: Proposed minimums: 1) committed PM/Eng sponsor 2) 3–5 real end-users 3) data privacy ok with test env 4) measurable success metric (latency, cost per request, NPS).
Sara N: Love that. Can we add production-proxying tolerance? some partners need a canary path to prod, others just sandbox.
Kevin T: Suggest we weight criteria: commitment 30%, product-fit 25%, engineering readiness 20%, data sensitivity 15%, ability to provide labeled feedback 10%.
Alex P: Nice. Can you paste a tiny scoring matrix?
Kevin T: ```
Score matrix (0-5 per line)
- Sponsor commitment (SLA/meet cadence): 30%
- Product fit (maps to 2 core use cases): 25%
- Engineering readiness (infra + security): 20%
- Data sensitivity (low=better for early pilot): 15%
- Feedback quality (owns evals + provides logs): 10%
Total = weighted score * 5
```
Maria G: For recruitment messaging we should split into 2 buckets: Strategic sponsors (co-design + exec sponsorship) vs Tactical pilots (fast feedback, narrower scope). Different asks/cadence.
Ana R: Tactical pilot playbook idea: 4-week sprint, 2 weekly feedback sessions, canned PROMPT set we provide + 1 customization, weekly telemetry digest.
Jamie L: Strategic sponsor playbook: 12-week co-design, roadmap influence, joint PR optional, dedicated SE time, quarterly exec reviews.
Sara N: Routing feedback — propose this: 1) Partner fills feedback form (structured) 2) Feedback routes to product triage channel 3) Weekly sync summarizes action items to eng owners. Use webhook to auto-create JIRA when severity>=P2.
Alex P: Agree. Who owns the feedback form + webhook glue?
Kevin T: Solutions owns the forms, Eng Infra owns webhook + JIRA automation. I'll take infra. @Maria G can you own the form?
Maria G: Yep I can. Will draft today and share.
DevBot: New doc created: <https://redwood.docs/pilot-playbooks/pilot-sponsor-selection-draft> (access: product+solutions).
Ana R: Quick question on launch criteria — do we require performance parity (within X% of hosted) or allow staged degradation?
Jamie L: Recommend staged: must meet reliability targets (uptime, 99p latency SLO) and not exceed cost threshold. Quality can be allowed to be slightly lower but we need no critical regressions on 5 safety prompts.
Alex P: Let's define specific numbers in the playbook: uptime >= 99.5%, 99p latency < 450ms for core path, cost per 1k tokens <= $Y (tbd).
Maria G: I'll add those as placeholders. Also include a clause for rollback + stop criteria if hallucination > X or latency > threshold for 3 consecutive days.
Sara N: Onboard checklist for partners: NDA, data ingestion spec, contact matrix, spike window (dates), evaluation set.
Kevin T: For recruitment cadence: outreach email -> 1 week to reply -> 30-min intro -> qualification survey -> schedule kickoff. Aim to close 6 tactical pilots in first 6 weeks.
Ana R: What about incentives? credit + SE hours + product feature priority. That has worked historically.
Alex P: Yes. Offer $5k credit + 6 SE hours for tactical; Strategic get co-dev credits + prioritized roadmap slot.
Jamie L: One more: sample qualification questions (keep short): 1) Primary use case 2) Monthly active users impacted 3) Security/regulatory constraints 4) Who is the sponsor 5) Success metric (one line)
Maria G: I'll wire up the Google form. Can we also add a quick scoring column so we can filter by score?
Kevin T: I'll make a small script to ingest responses and output weighted score. Put responses in a shared sheet.
Alex P: Next steps & owners: Maria -> form + outreach template; Kevin -> scoring script + JIRA webhook; Ana -> tactical playbook doc (4-week); Jamie -> strategic playbook doc (12-week); Sara -> feedback routing runbook + stop criteria. I'll own the shortlist and exec review.
Ana R: I'll draft the tactical playbook by EOD Thursday.
Maria G: Outreach template first draft by tomorrow noon.
Kevin T: Script prototype by Friday.
Jamie L: Strategic playbook draft next Tuesday.
Sara N: Routing runbook and stop criteria by next Wed.
Alex P: Great. Let's reconvene Tues 10am to review shortlist. Thanks team :thumbsup:
